alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window. A small amber block figure with white eyes is already swaying and singing in the very first frame, with speech bubbles that say la la la, oh oh oh, yeah yeah, la la la, each with a happy pulse. It grows a little taller with confidence. In the last second the text changes from: me knowing every word, to: the second verse: mm mm mm, and the bubble turns to mm mm mm. The figure's eyes go wide and it trembles, then it narrows its eyes at the camera.
